contentText:
Elizabeth Dias / New York Times :

Interviews with Anthropic co-founder Christopher Olah and 20 religious and philosophical leaders about their summits to investigate consciousness in Claude   —  “To be clear,” Christopher Olah told me, “we don't know if A.I. models are conscious.  I don't know.  I'm genuinely uncertain.
